name: Cloud
description: The minimal-agent cloud connector. It owns the network transport to the cloud backend and registers that transport in the host transport registry. Thus the Intercom peers and teams span machines, and Intercom does not import this plugin. Tools: CloudLogin, CloudStatus, CloudPush.

tool.name: CloudStatus
tool.description: Show the status of the minimal-agent cloud plugin. The tool shows if the cloud functions are on, the cloud flags, the backend URL, and if the network transport is in the registry. If the transport is not in the registry, the tool also adds it. You can use it again safely.

format.description: The output format. The default is `text`.

tool.reason: the plugin name Cloud is already in the tool name

tool.name: CloudLogin
tool.description: Log this CLI in to the minimal-agent cloud backend with the OAuth device flow (RFC 8628). The tool shows a user code and a URL for approval in a browser. Then it saves the access token on this computer. After the login, `CloudPush` and the peers on other computers operate. To set the backend, set `MINIMAL_AGENT_CLOUD_URL` (default `http://localhost:4000/api/auth`).
tool.reason: the plugin name Cloud is already in the tool name

tool.name: CloudPush
tool.description: Upload the new entries of this session to the cloud immediately. Then the user can see the session live on the web or a mobile device. The tool sends only the entries that the cloud does not have, thus you can use it again safely. It operates only after `CloudLogin` and when the cloud functions are on. The harness also does this automatically between turns.
